dedupe_keys.name: simulation of post fire seismic response of planar reinforced concrete walls

description: Simulation of Post-Fire Seismic Response of Planar Reinforced Concrete Walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Anna Birely, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This dataset contains simulations of the post-fire earthquake response of flexure-controlled planar reinforced concrete walls. The dataset is intended to provide a resource for future experimental/simulation studies on the post-fire seismic performance of reinforced concrete elements and may also be useful in developing simplified design and evaluation tools. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS22T12. Keywords: seismic; fire; reinforced concrete; wall; opensees; safir; post-earthquake fire; multihazard. Published 2018-05-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
